name: insertionSort_sum
prelude:
def insertN (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertN x ys
def insertionSort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertN x (insertionSort xs)
def total : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + total xs
statement: theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs
proofs:
have inserted (x : Nat) (ys : List Nat) : total (insertN x ys) = x + total ys := by
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp [insertN, total]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : x ≤ y <;> simp [insertN, total, h, ih] <;> omega
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [insertionSort, total, inserted, ih]
  have inserted (x : Nat) (ys : List Nat) : List.Perm (insertN x ys) (x :: ys) := by
    induction ys with
    | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [insertN, h]
      · simp only [insertN, ite_eq_right h]
        exact (List.Perm.cons y ih).trans (List.Perm.swap x y ys)
  have permutation (ys : List Nat) : List.Perm (insertionSort ys) ys := by
    induction ys with
    | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons y ys ih => exact (inserted y (insertionSort ys)).trans (List.Perm.cons y ih)
  have invariant (as bs : List Nat) (h : List.Perm as bs) : total as = total bs := by
    induction h with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x h ih => simp [total, ih]
    | swap x y zs => simp [total]; omega
    | trans h1 h2 i1 i2 => exact i1.trans i2
  exact invariant _ _ (permutation xs)
strategies: Prove insertion adds its element to total, then induct on the input.
Prove sorting preserves permutation and prove total invariant under permutation.
